description: List reverse-split episodes ACROSS COMPANIES that ended WITHOUT the split taking effect, from Signal8's SEC-filing tracker: outcome "vote_failed" (shareholders did not approve), "abandoned" (the company said it will not proceed), "authority_expired" (an approval lapsed unused past its stated deadline) or "postponed_indefinitely". Splits that DID happen are not here (get_reverse_splits_list, view "recent"); one company's full history is get_reverse_split_lifecycle. Newest end first. Each row is the Reverse Splits page row (ticker, companyName, hasPage, ratio / ratioMin / ratioMax, trackerState, meetingDate, approvedDate, exchange, securityType, marketCapUsd, cik, approvalPath, domicile, splitAuthority, authorityTerms, verification) plus sourceUrl / sourceAccession and sourceDocuments (EVERY document behind the episode, each with accession or URL; cite them) and an "ended" block: outcome, outcomeLabel, endedOn, endedOnBasis, closedReason (the tracker's own note, verbatim), voteDate, closingAccession / closingUrl (the filing that closed it, when one did). 🔴 endedOnBasis says what endedOn IS: "vote_date" or "meeting_date" = the vote as stated; "authority_expiry" = the stated last day of the authority; "closing_filing" = the ET day of the filing that closed it; "recorded" = none of those, the day the TRACKER recorded the close, which can be later than the event. Say which. 🔴 NULL MEANS NOT MEASURED OR NOT STATED. An EMPTY list is what the tracker has on file for the window, never "no company abandoned a split"; completeness "tracked_episodes" = what the tracker has read from filings since it started, not every company. boundReached: true = the window held more episodes than one read returns; narrow it with from / to. 🔴 LOCKED ROWS ARE WITHHELD, NOT ABSENT. The facts are Signal8 Pro. A key not owned by a Pro account gets rows with locked: true and ONLY ticker, companyName, hasPage and exchange (access "preview", lockedCount); never read a locked row as anything but "facts withheld", and tell the user they need Signal8 Pro. outcome, from and to are Pro-only filters: on a non-Pro key they apply to unlocked rows only and locked rows are left out (filtersLimitedToUnlocked: true). exchange applies to every row. Page with limit and the nextCursor of the previous response (null = last page). available: false (reason "tracker_not_enabled") = the tracker is switched off; an HTTP 503 FEATURE_DISABLED = the Reverse Splits page is switched off. In both cases say it is unavailable and say nothing about any company. Describe what is on file; give no view on the company, its price, or what anyone should do.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

exchange.description: Listing venues to keep: NASDAQ, NYSE, AMEX (NYSE American), OTC, or not_measured. Empty = every row.

outcome.description: Outcomes to keep: vote_failed, abandoned, authority_expired, postponed_indefinitely. Empty = all four.

to.description: Latest endedOn, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today, US Eastern).

name: get_ended_reverse_splits
title: Get Ended Reverse Splits
